ns0:g.ns0:text: More equal CSTRs in series approach plug-flow conversion at fixed total space time
Isothermal first-order reaction, fixed total τ=10 min,k=0.2 min⁻¹, constant volumetric flow. N=1 gives X=0.6667,N=2 gives0.7500,N=5 gives0.8141,N=10
gives0.8385. Schematic rows are examples; plot reaches30 tanks. Equal tank volume and ideal mixing are assumed.
